items.q: Which programmes does Easwari Engineering College offer?
items.a: 15 undergraduate programmes (B.E. and B.Tech.) and, at postgraduate level, MBA, MCA, M.E. in five specialisations and Ph.D. in all disciplines.

items.q: What is the eligibility for B.E. / B.Tech.?
items.a: As per AICTE, Government of Tamil Nadu and Anna University norms, a pass in the Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry is required.

items.q: What is the eligibility for postgraduate programmes?
items.a: As per AICTE and Anna University norms.
Yes. Easwari Engineering College is an autonomous institution affiliated to Anna University.
Register yourself, verify your mobile number and email ID, fill the application form, upload the required documents and submit the application form.
Call +91 8939628204 or toll-free 1800 103 2535, or email helpdesk@eec.srmrmp.edu.in.

_notes: hero.headline: the live headline 'Inspiring you towards excellence and a bright future.' (53 chars) cannot fit two ~22-char lines; trimmed to its opening words ['Inspiring you towards', 'excellence']. The full sentence is used verbatim as promo.heading.
hero.formHeading 'Admissions Open 2027': our wording (live hero says 'Registration Open for 2027', used verbatim as hero.button).
meta.shortName, meta.whyLabel ('Why SRM EEC', from the 'Why SRM EEC ?' heading) and meta.videoTitle ('SRM Easwari Engineering College', from src/data/institutions/easwari.ts) are ours.
why.heading: live text 'Why SRM EEC ?' with the stray space before '?' removed. The live section has no intro text, so why.intro is omitted.

rankings: the live 'Accreditation & Ranking in 2025' section shows NBA, NAAC and NIRF logos only (no grade/rank text). item.text is our acronym expansion (National Board of Accreditation / National Assessment and Accreditation Council / National Institutional Ranking Framework); no grade, rank or accredited-programme claim is made.
rankings item 'Autonomous' ('An Autonomous Institution, Affiliated to Anna University') is taken from the official logo artwork, not from page text.
promo.text joins the two live paragraphs under 'Inspiring you towards excellence and a bright future.'; videoUrl is the live YouTube embed with '?rel=0' appended.

stats1 / facts: values from the live stat row (1424+ Students Placed, 16K+ Alumni, 432 Companies Visited, 29 Years of Excellence). '51 LPA' is taken from the heading '2025 Record Setting Placements With Highest Package of 51 LPA from Top Companies'; the label 'Highest Package' is ours. stats2 omitted (only two academic/scale figures on the site). Fact icons chosen by us.

programmes: faculty groups 'UNDERGRADUATE' / 'POSTGRADUATE' are the live tab names; section is null (no sub-headings on the site). Ph.D. is listed under the live POSTGRADUATE tab; level set to 'PhD'. Lateral entry, part-time and duration are not published (set false / omitted).
steps.items: transcribed from the live 'Steps to Apply' graphic (no HTML text).
collaborations: names read from the logo artwork (logos have no alt/text on the live page). Heading 'Global Academic Celebration' is verbatim.

placements: heading 'Our Star Achievers' verbatim; no placement cards on the site (omitted). Profiles show no company or department on the live page, so those fields are omitted. Each card also shows 'intern - Software Development Engineer' and (for five of six) a monthly stipend, which have no field in the contract and are not included.
ctaHeading: verbatim heading of the live record-placements band ('2025 Record Setting Placements With Highest Package of 51 LPA from Top Companies').
campus: heading 'Life at SRM Easwari', item titles and tags are ours. Photos are official site images (also used in 'Why SRM EEC' and the hero background); image alt texts are ours (from easwari.ts).

testimonials: line3 'SRM Easwari Alumni' is ours (based on the live 'Alumni Testimonials' heading). Mr. Venky has no role/company on the live page (line2 empty). Aswanth Ram A S's line2: missing space added in 'Technology, Chicago'. Kishore V's quote ends mid-sentence ('The EEE dept.') as on the live page. 'Eeswari' spelling kept as published.

faqs: the live page has no FAQ section. Heading and questions are ours; answers restate live-site facts only (programme list, eligibility text, steps to apply, contact details, and 'autonomous / affiliated to Anna University' from the logo).

contact: phone displays are verbatim. The live toll-free link is 'tel:+9118001032535'; href changed to 'tel:18001032535' so it dials. No map image or landmarks on the live page (a Google Maps embed only), so map/landmarks are omitted.
Not used from the live page: 'Need Assistance ?' headings (no CTA/links) and its stock-style background image.
